  users.push({ email: req.body.email, password })
  res.status(201).json({ email: req.body.email })
})

  const user = users.find((item) => item.email === req.body.email)

  res.json({ token })
})

jwt.verify throws on a bad token, so catch it and return 401.

```js
const jwt = require("jsonwebtoken")

function requireToken(req, res, next) {
  const header = req.headers.authorization ?? ""
  if (!header.startsWith("Bearer ")) return res.status(401).json({ error: "missing token" })
  let decoded
  try {
    decoded = jwt.verify(header.slice(7), process.env.JWT_SECRET)
  } catch {
    return res.status(401).json({ error: "invalid token" })
  }
  req.user = { email: decoded.email }
  next()
}

module.exports = { requireToken }
```<|im_end|>

```tsx
import { useState } from "react"
import { FlatList, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from "react-native"
import NoteRow from "../components/NoteRow"

export default function HomeScreen() {
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("")

  function addNote() {
    const text = draft.trim()
    if (text.length === 0) return
    setNotes((current) => [...current, text])
    setDraft("")
  }

  return (
    <View>
      <TextInput value={draft} onChangeText={setDraft} placeholder="New note" />
      <TouchableOpacity onPress={addNote}>
        <Text>Add note</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
      <FlatList data={notes} renderItem={({ item }) => <NoteRow text={item} />} keyExtractor={(item) => item} />
    </View>
  )
}
```<|im_end|>

import argparse
import csv
import json


def summarise(path):
    with open(path, newline="") as handle:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(handle))
    return {"rows": len(rows), "columns": list(rows[0].keys()) if rows else []}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("path")
    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    summary = summarise(args.path)
    print(json.dumps(summary) if args.json else summary)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

import argparse

import json


def summarise(path):

    return {"rows": len(rows), "columns": list(rows[0].keys()) if rows else []}


def main():

    parser.add_argument("path")
    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true")

```js
const jwt = require("jsonwebtoken")

function requireToken(req, res, next) {
  const header = req.headers.authorization ?? ""
  if (!header.startsWith("Bearer ")) return res.status(401).json({ error: "missing token" })
  let decoded
  try {
    decoded = jwt.verify(header.slice(7), process.env.JWT_SECRET)
  } catch {
    return res.status(401).json({ error: "invalid token" })
  }
  req.user = { email: decoded.email }
  next()
}

module.exports = { requireToken }
```<|im_end|>

```ts
import { useState } from "react"

export interface User {
  email: string
}

export function useAuth() {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null)

  async function login(email: string, password: string) {
    const response = await fetch("/api/login", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ email, password }),
    })
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Invalid credentials")
    setUser((await response.json()) as User)
  }

  return { user, setUser, login }
}
```<|im_end|>

import { useState } from "react"
import { FlatList, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from "react-native"
import NoteRow from "../components/NoteRow"

export default function HomeScreen() {
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("")

  function addNote() {
    const text = draft.trim()
    if (text.length === 0) return
    setNotes((current) => [...current, text])
    setDraft("")
  }

  return (
    <View>
      <TextInput value={draft} onChangeText={setDraft} placeholder="New note" />
      <TouchableOpacity onPress={addNote}>
        <Text>Add note</Text>
      </TouchableOpacity>
      <FlatList data={notes} renderItem={({ item }) => <NoteRow text={item} />} keyExtractor={(item) => item} />
    </View>
  )
}
